points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers read correctly, with digits and symbols in the right order?
Is the amount due the clearest thing on the screen?
Does the back arrow in the header point right?
Does the due date show both a Gregorian and a Hijri date, each with day, month and year?
Does the phone example 050 123 4567 keep its digits in order?
Does the line about 3 items show the number 3 next to the Arabic word for items?
Is the amount 1,234.50 shown with AED next to it and its digits in order?
Is the spacing even and the page tidy, with nothing cramped, overlapping or out of line?
